verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents deduplicating or grouping related alerts into a single incident. The nearest claim is bulk acknowledgement: '30 incidents get created at the same time. Acknowledge them with a single tap.' That is an adjacent feature, and it actually implies many separate incidents are created and ring the responder. Escalation and routing evidence is about who gets paged, not about collapsing duplicates, so this applicable axis earns no credit.
